Applications & Components → Comma → Macros, **Modeling** tab. Select the object(s) first, then run the macro — macros act on the current selection rather than prompting you to pick.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ureverserebar.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uReverseRebar

Reverses the picked shape/range of a selected rebar object — flips a `SingleRebar`'s polygon point order, a `RebarGroup`/`CurvedRebarGroup`/`CircleRebarGroup`/`RebarMesh`'s start/end direction. Select exactly one object, then run.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ureversehook.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uReverseHook

Reverses the hook direction (negates the hook angle) on the start and end hooks of the selected rebar object(s) — works on `SingleRebar`, `RebarGroup`, `CurvedRebarGroup`, `CircleRebarGroup`, `RebarSet`, and `RebarMesh`, and accepts a multi-object selection.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uopenprojectuda.png" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uOpenProjectUDA

Opens the Project user-defined attributes dialog and jumps straight to the Classification field. No selection needed. (The same macro is also available in Drawing mode — see below.)

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/ushowonlyselected.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uShowOnlySelected

Hides everything except the selected objects. Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> while running it to show the other objects as transparent instead of hiding them.

## <img class="tool-icon" src="../../../../images/tekla/tools/macros/uhideselected.svg" alt="" width="24" height="24" style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;background:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px" /> uHideSelected

The opposite of uShowOnlySelected: hides exactly the selected objects, completely (no reference line left), and leaves everything else visible. Selecting an assembly or component hides everything in it. Hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> to make them transparent instead of hidden. Redraw the view to show them again.
